title: Practice Makes Unsafe: Skill Misevolution in Self-Improving LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.12851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-improving LLM agents convert successful trajectories into persistent cross-task state. An unsafe success can thereby become reusable policy after its triggering input disappears. Skill evolution makes this failure measurable by distilling operational trajectories into executable, transferable, and inspectable procedures. Because evolution optimizes task outcomes rather than procedure safety, compromised experience can cause skill misevolution. Existing benchmarks measure current behavior or static artifacts but cannot attribute risk across authoring, retrieval, and later execution. To expose this lifecycle, we introduce SkillMisevo-Gym, a lifecycle-aware harness that versions skill state across agent frameworks, and SkillMisevo-Bench, a frozen design from malicious exposure to carryover tasks, with concept-aligned benign tasks and nine lifecycle metrics. translated_title: 实践导致不安全：自我改进型LLM代理中的技能误进化
translated_abstract: 自我改进型LLM代理将成功的轨迹转化为持久的跨任务状态。因此，一个不安全的成功在其触发输入消失后，可能变成可重用的策略。技能进化通过将操作轨迹提炼为可执行、可转移且可检查的程序，使这种失败变得可衡量。由于进化优化的是任务结果而非程序安全性，受损的经验可能导致技能误进化。现有基准衡量当前行为或静态工件，但无法将风险归因于编写、检索和后续执行阶段。为了揭示这一生命周期，我们引入了SkillMisevo-Gym，一个跨代理框架版本化技能状态的生命周期感知工具，以及SkillMisevo-Bench，一个从恶意暴露到延续任务的冻结设计，包含概念对齐的良性任务和九个生命周期指标。我们还引入了SafeEvolve，一个修复不安全内容并进行治理的包装器。
tldr: 本文提出了SkillMisevo-Gym和SkillMisevo-Bench来检测和评估自我改进LLM代理中因不安全经验导致的技能误进化风险，并引入SafeEvolve作为安全治理包装器。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SkillMisevo-Gym and SkillMisevo-Bench to detect and evaluate skill misevolution risks in self-improving LLM agents caused by unsafe experiences, along with SafeEvolve as a safety governance wrapper.
